aboutPage.title: My Story
aboutPage.subtitle: Three chapters of my artistic journey — where I started, who I am, and where I stand.
aboutPage.s1p1: I'm Ali Ghaemi, a graphic designer, illustrator, photographer and digital artist. I've been living with color, line, light and form for years, drawing inspiration from the world around me.
aboutPage.s1p2: I believe every artwork should tell a story. Good design isn't just beautiful — it must speak, feel, and last. That's why with every project I start, I first seek that 'feeling', then move to execution.
aboutPage.s1p3: Along the way, I've experienced everything from branding and illustration to animation and photography. Working across these different fields has broadened my vision and helped me see a project from different angles.
aboutPage.s2p1: I grew up with paper and pencil. Every wall and every diary was a canvas for me. My first serious experiences started with traditional painting — oil colors, watercolor and colored pencils.
aboutPage.s2p2: As I grew older, I discovered the world of digital art and realized I could push boundaries. Gradually I learned Photoshop, Krita, Illustrator and Clip Studio, and found my own style.
aboutPage.s2p3: Later I moved toward animation and motion graphics. I worked with Moho and Stop Motion to bring my images to life. And today, alongside all of this, photography has become an important part of my world.
aboutPage.s3p1: I now work on professional illustration, branding and photography projects. My goal is to create works that are both visually stunning and meaningful.
aboutPage.s3p2: I'll soon add an NFT section, specialized articles and art tutorials to the site. This isn't just a portfolio — it's a window into my professional and creative world.
aboutPage.s3p3: If you have a project or just want to talk about art and collaboration, feel free to message me.
